title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno/Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Pleno/Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na construção e evolução de plataformas modernas de dados, trabalhando com arquiteturas escaláveis e processamento de alta volumetria...

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com forte experiência em cloud, pipelines distribuídos e ambientes analíticos modernos...

Se você domina PySpark, AWS, Databricks e soluções de Data Lake/Data Warehouse , essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, estruturar e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT escaláveis utilizando PySpark, AWS Glue, Databricks e AWS EMR
  • Processar grandes volumes de dados com foco em performance, confiabilidade e escalabilidade
  • Implementar arquiteturas robustas para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados
  • Estruturar e administrar ambientes de Data Lake em AWS S3
  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e soluções de Data Warehouse em Amazon Redshift
  • Garantir qualidade, governança, integridade e segurança dos dados
  • Criar, monitorar e otimizar workflows e DAGs no Apache Airflow
  • Gerenciar dependências complexas e garantir estabilidade das rotinas de dados
  • Automatizar processos orientados a eventos e integrações em tempo real
  • Desenvolver soluções de processamento de dados em streaming
  • Implementar estratégias de Change Data Capture (CDC) e migração de dados utilizando AWS DMS
  • Integrar dados provenientes de bancos relacionais e não relacionais
  • Otimizar estruturas de armazenamento e particionamento de dados em Delta
  • Disponibilizar dados para consultas performáticas via AWS Athena
  • Realizar tuning de queries SQL, jobs Spark e monitoramento de performance da infraestrutura


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL
  • Experiência com PySpark
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento de pipelines ETL/ELT
  • Conhecimento em Clean Code e boas práticas de engenharia
  • Experiência com AWS S3, AWS Glue, AWS EMR, AWS Athena, AWS Lambda, AWS Kinesis e AWS DMS
  • Conhecimento em DynamoDB e Amazon Redshift
  • Experiência com Databricks e Apache Airflow
  • Vivência com Git e versionamento de código
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD aplicado a dados
  • Experiência com arquitetura Data Lake e Data Warehouse
  • Conhecimento em BigQuery
  • Experiência com modelagem, particionamento e otimização de custos e consultas em GCP
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas
  • Perfil colaborativo e boa comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Senso de dono, proatividade e autonomia
  • Facilidade de atuação em ambientes multidisciplinares

Diferencial

  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos
  • Vivência com ambientes analíticos de grande volume
  • Atuação integrada com times de BI, Analytics e Ciência de Dados


Formato de trabalho

  • Modelo 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Python em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor Python


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor(a) Python com experiência em desenvolvimento de soluções web e integração com serviços em nuvem. O profissional atuará em projetos desafiadores, com foco em construção e evolução de aplicações, processamento de dados e desenvolvimento de APIs e interfaces.


Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em Python com foco em qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

- Criar e evoluir serviços de back-end utilizando Python e NET Core

- Familiaridade com desenvolvimento de APIs e integração entre sistemas.

- Boa capacidade de análise, organização e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

- Experiência com ambientes de dados e pipelines ETL/ELT.

title: Arquiteto de soluções (Pre-Vendas)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções (Pre-Vendas) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um profissional para reforçar o time de pré-vendas, atuando como elo entre cliente, time comercial e áreas técnicas. O perfil ideal combina bagagem consultiva, fluência técnica e capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio em soluções estruturadas, com velocidade na construção de materiais e energia para conduzir conversas estratégicas em ambiente client facing.


Atividades:

  • Apoiar o time comercial em oportunidades de pré-vendas, conduzindo discovery, levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções end to end.
  • Construir propostas técnico-comerciais, decks executivos e materiais de apoio para conversas com C-level e áreas de negócio do cliente.
  • Conduzir reuniões client facing, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em arquitetura de solução viável e financeiramente saudável.
  • Conectar áreas internas (delivery, parceiros, especialistas e fornecedores) para construir respostas integradas dentro dos prazos comerciais.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e movimentos da concorrência, contribuindo com a evolução do portfólio de ofertas para a vertical.


Necessário:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente com pós-graduação ou MBA em gestão de projetos, transformação digital ou afins.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria, integradores de TI ou times de pré-vendas, atendendo clientes de grande porte da vertical industrial (óleo e gás, manufatura, utilities ou energia).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe) e gestão de projetos, com vivência prática em ambientes de delivery complexo.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL) e leitura técnica de soluções de tecnologia.
  • Inglês avançado para interlocução com fornecedores, parceiros e times globais.
  • Postura consultiva, clareza de comunicação, velocidade na produção de materiais e energia para conectar pessoas e conduzir o ambiente.


Diferencial:

  • Certificações como Professional Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, PMP ou similares.
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital em ambientes industriais ou cadeias produtivas afins.
  • Vivência prévia com clientes do setor de M&M, Auto/Equipamentos, CPG/Agri, Oil and Gas e Manufatura Avançada.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno/Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Pleno/Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na construção e evolução de plataformas modernas de dados, trabalhando com arquiteturas escaláveis e processamento de alta volumetria...

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com forte experiência em cloud, pipelines distribuídos e ambientes analíticos modernos...

Se você domina PySpark, AWS, Databricks e soluções de Data Lake/Data Warehouse , essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, estruturar e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT escaláveis utilizando PySpark, AWS Glue, Databricks e AWS EMR
  • Processar grandes volumes de dados com foco em performance, confiabilidade e escalabilidade
  • Implementar arquiteturas robustas para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados
  • Estruturar e administrar ambientes de Data Lake em AWS S3
  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e soluções de Data Warehouse em Amazon Redshift
  • Garantir qualidade, governança, integridade e segurança dos dados
  • Criar, monitorar e otimizar workflows e DAGs no Apache Airflow
  • Gerenciar dependências complexas e garantir estabilidade das rotinas de dados
  • Automatizar processos orientados a eventos e integrações em tempo real
  • Desenvolver soluções de processamento de dados em streaming
  • Implementar estratégias de Change Data Capture (CDC) e migração de dados utilizando AWS DMS
  • Integrar dados provenientes de bancos relacionais e não relacionais
  • Otimizar estruturas de armazenamento e particionamento de dados em Delta
  • Disponibilizar dados para consultas performáticas via AWS Athena
  • Realizar tuning de queries SQL, jobs Spark e monitoramento de performance da infraestrutura


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL
  • Experiência com PySpark
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento de pipelines ETL/ELT
  • Conhecimento em Clean Code e boas práticas de engenharia
  • Experiência com AWS S3, AWS Glue, AWS EMR, AWS Athena, AWS Lambda, AWS Kinesis e AWS DMS
  • Conhecimento em DynamoDB e Amazon Redshift
  • Experiência com Databricks e Apache Airflow
  • Vivência com Git e versionamento de código
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD aplicado a dados
  • Experiência com arquitetura Data Lake e Data Warehouse
  • Conhecimento em BigQuery
  • Experiência com modelagem, particionamento e otimização de custos e consultas em GCP
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas
  • Perfil colaborativo e boa comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Senso de dono, proatividade e autonomia
  • Facilidade de atuação em ambientes multidisciplinares

Diferencial

  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos
  • Vivência com ambientes analíticos de grande volume
  • Atuação integrada com times de BI, Analytics e Ciência de Dados


Formato de trabalho

  • Modelo 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month


We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2B SaaS business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.


The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership
  • High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform
  • A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering
  • Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)


If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership
  • High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform
  • A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering
  • Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)


If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Annotation & Review Specialist(Polish)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Annotation & Review Specialist(Polish) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Annotation & Review Specialist

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a High school or above degree

Language Required : Polish



We are seeking for detail-oriented and quality-focused individuals to join our team as Annotation & Review Specialists. This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform annotation tasks on images and videos as per project guidelines.
  • Review annotated images and video content to ensure accuracy and quality standards are met.
  • Provide clear and constructive feedback on annotations and identify areas requiring correction or improvement.
  • Follow project instructions, workflows, and timelines consistently.
  • Maintain high attention to detail while handling large volumes of data.
  • Collaborate with the quality and project teams to improve annotation accuracy and efficiency.



Required Skills & Qualifications


  • High school or Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with online tools/platforms.
  • Prior experience in annotation, data labeling, or quality review is an added advantage.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month


We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2B SaaS business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.


The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership
  • High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform
  • A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering
  • Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)


If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Realizar auxílios técnicos a equipes de desenvolvedores e/ou suporte, em situações em que se faça necessária a análise de código-fonte ou de análise de falhas sem simulação;
  • Participação ativa nos demais rituais do time (daily, retro, planning, check-in…)


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento web de soluções escaláveis
  • Conhecimento em testes de software.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara, proatividade, autonomia e perfil de liderança técnica.

  • Vivência em desenvolvimento com PHP


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Vivencia em desenvolvimento com VueJs
  • Vivência com trabalhos segundo metodologia ágil
  • Recomendado conhecimento em tecnologias: Git e CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados MySQL
  • Vivência com sistemas de alto volume de dados;
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e/ou aceitação);
  • Vivência em projetos SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em uso de IA;
  • Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de aplicação prática de agentes de IA no dia a dia.

Software Engineer

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month


We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2B SaaS business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.


The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership
  • High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform
  • A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering
  • Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)


If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Desenvolvedor Python Especialista - IA Generativa
description:

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa especialista em desenvolvimento backend com foco em Python para fortalecer plataformas e serviços críticos. A posição é estratégica e voltada à excelência técnica, com impacto direto em soluções que atendem milhões de clientes. Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em microserviços, APIs escaláveis e aplicações robustas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:

  • Desenvolver serviços backend robustos, reutilizáveis e de alta performance com Python.
  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas de microserviços com foco em modularidade e escalabilidade.
  • Construir APIs RESTful com versionamento, autenticação e segurança.
  • Garantir qualidade e performance com práticas avançadas de testes e otimizações.
  • Automatizar processos de build, testes e publicação de bibliotecas internas.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de padrões e disseminação de boas práticas.
  • Investigar falhas e propor melhorias estruturais em produção.
  • Integrar sistemas legados e externos com boas práticas de interoperabilidade.
  • Colaborar com arquitetura, produto, QA e operações em soluções técnicas alinhadas ao negócio.


Perfil esperado:

  • Comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Tomada de decisão técnica com foco em simplicidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Capacidade de transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções viáveis.
  • Postura colaborativa e foco em entrega contínua.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Proficiência em Python com Django, Flask ou FastAPI.
  • Desenvolvimento backend end-to-end em arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Controle de versão (Git), build automation e gestão de dependências (pipenv, poetry).
  • Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e uso de Redis.
  • Design e versionamento de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e TDD.

  • CI/CD e versionamento semântico.
  • Otimização de performance em aplicações Python.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em NoSQL, Elasticsearch e mecanismos de busca.
  • Clean Architecture, DDD, Hexagonal e 12-Factor App.
  • Scripts de automação (Bash/Shell) e empacotamento de bibliotecas internas.
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, CloudWatch, Splunk).
  • Vivência em ambientes multicloud e foco em otimização de custos.
  • Segurança de software (OWASP, OAuth 2.0, JWT) e governança técnica.

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist - Especialista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções.
  • Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis.
  • Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados.
  • Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema.
  • Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança.
  • Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação.
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost.
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares).
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas.
  • Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes.
  • Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares.
  • Experiência em varejo.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.
